metadata.causal_interval: turn start within the preceding 72 hours and before record minute + one minute
metadata.fallback_caveat: full neighboring sessions are an upper-bound oracle stage, not a safe semantic stop or recommended curator payload
metadata.ranked_fallback: when window results are supplied, union the baseline 20-turn envelope with top lexical spans from the hybrid nearby-session pool
metadata.session_order: last eligible turn timestamp descending; repository affinity is an ablation, not a hard production filter
metadata.source_policy: gold citations used for evaluation only; no label-aware selection
metadata.text_rank: max visible user/assistant/reasoning-summary lexical overlap with the already-written decision record; retrospective only
